# Zstandard

Upstream: https://github.com/facebook/zstd/tree/v1.5.7/lib

Version: 1.5.7. Unmodified public headers and common/compress/decompress C sources.
Isaac LAN uses the BSD license in `LICENSE`; the upstream alternative license is
retained in `COPYING`. Builds disable legacy formats, assembly and multithreading.
Dictionary training and command-line programs are not included.
